Closeout GatesLink

GatePass StandardFounder Stop Rule
Customer remedy gateRemedy range, customer language, account impact, and exposure math are current.Do not finalize credit or replacement while exposure is still directional.
Supplier recovery gateTraceability, photos, loading proof, CAPA, shipment review, and supplier response support the offset request.Do not overclaim supplier recovery from incomplete proof.
CAPA gateRoot cause, corrective action, preventive verification, owner, and next comparable-cycle proof are current.Do not call recovery closed while recurrence control is unproven.
Profitability gateCredit, replacement cost, supplier offset, unrecovered loss, and margin effect are posted to trade profitability.Do not let commercial peace hide realized economics.
Supplier consequence gateSupplier performance and approval posture absorb the final claim outcome.Do not let supplier trust improve while case evidence remains unresolved.
Archive gateClaim, recovery, CAPA, supplier consequence, account posture, and economics are retrievable and aligned.Do not archive while recovery or proof can still change.

Escalation and Stop RulesLink

TriggerImmediate MoveFounder Protection
Commercial team pushes remedy before supplier recovery logic is visibleHold remedy range and refresh customer account, recovery module, and supplier proof.Prevents fast relationship repair from hiding loss.
Supplier evidence package remains incompleteKeep supplier recovery confidence bounded and refresh traceability, CAPA, shipment review, and supplier performance.Prevents weak offset claim and future trust inflation.
Claim closes without profitability updateReopen finance posting through trade profitability before closure.Makes margin leakage visible.
CAPA verification remains directionalFreeze closure language and refresh CAPA governance.Prevents recurrence risk from being disguised as resolved.
Account trust weakens after remedy discussionReturn to customer account review and trust posture before further credit or release movement.Keeps relationship protection tied to controls.
Any linked layer contradicts recovery postureRun control integrity before founder approval.Protects decision quality across commercial, compliance, supplier, and finance layers.
